declaration.negotiation_history_statement: On behalf of interim class counsel, I submit this declaration in support of preliminary approval. The parties negotiated a settlement that provides a $32 million class fund for approximately 400,000 members, with payments distributed automatically using Brightline’s records rather than through a claims process. Our opening proposal was a $38 million class fund and $6 million in fees and expenses. Brightline countered with a $30 million fund and $5 million in fees and expenses. We then proposed a $33 million fund with $5 million in fees and expenses; Brightline responded with the agreed $32 million fund and $5 million in fees and expenses, which we accepted. Throughout the exchange, the proposed fees were subject to court approval, Brightline did not agree to refrain from opposing a fee request, and any fees not awarded would go to the class rather than revert to Brightline. Fees were included in the proposals from the first round; they were not first discussed after class relief was agreed. In my assessment, the $32 million fund—half of the disputed renewal charges—provides substantial, prompt relief without the risks and delay of certification, trial, and a possible recovery of nothing. The separate fee provision does not reduce the stated class fund. I believe the settlement is fair to the class, subject to the Court’s review and approval.
